foods.name: Apple
foods.explanation: Apples are a crunchy fruit with fibre and vitamins.

foods.name: Banana
foods.explanation: Bananas give you natural energy and potassium.

foods.name: Carrot
foods.explanation: Carrots are a colourful vegetable that help keep you healthy.

foods.name: Broccoli
foods.explanation: Broccoli is a green vegetable packed with vitamins.

foods.name: Water
foods.explanation: Water is the best everyday drink for your body.

foods.name: Yogurt
foods.explanation: Plain yogurt has protein that helps your bones and muscles.

foods.name: Salmon
foods.explanation: Salmon is a fish that gives your body healthy fats.

foods.name: Oatmeal
foods.explanation: Oatmeal is a filling breakfast that gives lasting energy.

foods.name: Candy
foods.explanation: Candy has lots of sugar and is not an everyday food.

foods.name: Soda
foods.explanation: Soda is a sugary drink. Water is a healthier choice.

foods.name: Chips
foods.explanation: Chips are salty and fried, so they are less healthy.

foods.name: Doughnut
foods.explanation: Doughnuts are a sweet treat with lots of sugar and fat.

foods.name: Ice Cream
foods.explanation: Ice cream is a dessert. Enjoy it sometimes, not every day.

foods.name: Chocolate Bar
foods.explanation: Chocolate bars are high in sugar and are a sometimes food.

foods.name: Strawberry
foods.explanation: Strawberries are fruits with fibre and vitamin C.
